patch_description: This ansatz ties the collective RY and RZ layers to one angle per repeated block. It preserves the noncommuting rotation–entanglement–rotation structure that already achieves perfect accuracy while reducing circuit parameters from 12 to 6 and total trainable parameters from 14 to 8. This raises ideal parameter efficiency from 1/14 to 1/8, reduces optimization dimensionality, and is expected to retain or improve convergence speed and generalization through stronger symmetry-based regularization.
